name: Maelae Youth (Maelbud)
source: Mystical: Kingdom of Monsters Anniversary Edition
book: Mystical: Kingdom of Monsters Anniversary Edition

facets.bk: Mystical: Kingdom of Monsters Anniversary Edition

body:
Maelbud CR 6

XP 2,400
N Tiny plant
Init +10; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +23

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 19, flat-footed 13 (+6 Dex, +1 natural, +2 size)
hp 76 (9d8+36)
Fort +9, Ref +9, Will +5
Defensive Abilities thorn body (1d6+9); Immune electricity, plant traits; Weaknesses vulnerability to cold and fire

OFFENSE

Speed 15 ft.; climb 15 ft..
Space 2-1/2 ft.; Reach 0 ft.
Melee slam +8 (1d3 plus 1d6 piercing plus poison)
Ranged thorn +8 (15 ft., 1d6 piercing plus poison)
Special Attacks poison (DC 17, 1d2 Constitution, 1 save)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 6th)

At will—detect animals or plants
3/day—entangle (DC 16), magic fang

STATISTICS

Str 11, Dex 23, Con 17, Int 16, Wis 15, Cha 20
Base Atk +6; CMB +11; CMD 27 (can’t be tripped)
Feats Alertness, Combat Casting, Eschew Materials, Improved Initiative, Iron Will
Skills Diplomacy +17, Knowledge (nature) +15, Perception +14, Sense Motive +14, Stealth +26
Languages understands Common
SQ trainer spells (as scout, CL 6th)

ABOUT

Beware the viper in the roses. Young maelbuds are raised by the nest until they are grown enough to defend themselves.

Researchers are occasionally able to locate a breeding ground and bring back maelbuds, but most of those found with trainers are bred in captivity.
